metadata.title: Product Bricks
metadata.description: Logical responsibility model for Stripe-centered payments and revenue infrastructure, reviewed on 2026-11-15. Modules and delivery surfaces explain customer contracts; they are not a reconstruction of vendor internal services, databases or cloud topology. Investment statuses are modeling choices, not vendor roadmap commitments.
